content: Teaching machine to read and comprehend a given passage/paragraph and answer its corresponding questions is a challenging task. It is also one of the long-term goals of natural language understanding, and has important applications in e.g., building intelligent agents for conversation and customer service support. In a real world setting, it is necessary to judge whether the given questions are answerable given the available knowledge, and then generate correct answers for the ones which are able to infer an answer in the passage or an empty answer (as an unanswerable question) otherwise.
